result.title: MLIE-CoT: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Multi-Level Image Editing
result.summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective in improving the reasoning abilities of large language models by breaking complex tasks into step-by-step solutions. In recent years, researchers have attempted to extend CoT reasoning to visual generative models to improve their ability to handle complex tasks. However, existing CoT methods for text-to-image generation still rely mainly on textual reasoning and therefore cannot fully use and preserve the correct semantic information already present in an image, as even the most detailed language cannot capture all visual information. With advances in image generation, models such as FLUX and BAGEL can generate images conditioned on visual inputs. Recent work has attempted to carry images forward as context in the chain of thought, but this introduces another limitation: unsuitable earlier images can strongly interfere with the model, while repeated whole-image regeneration introduces new hallucinations at each round and causes them to accumulate. To address these issues, we propose MLIE-CoT, a visual chain-of-thought framework based on multi-level image editing. MLIE-CoT learns to select the repair granularity from three levels, preserving correct semantics whenever possible during reasoning while reducing the effect of incorrect content. To improve the ability of multimodal models to route errors of different severity to appropriate repair levels, we construct an image-repair dataset covering different error cases and use it to train a repair-level router. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MLIE-CoT significantly outperforms both its base models and methods using fixed repair strategies, producing clear improvements across multiple benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MLIE-CoT，将视觉思维链建模为多级图像编辑：从三种修复粒度中选择，尽量保留图像中已有的正确语义、削弱错误内容，并构建覆盖不同错误情况的图像修复数据集训练修复级路由器，在多个基准上超过基模型与固定修复策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 按错误严重程度路由编辑粒度的设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉状态的更新幅度、正确信息保留与逐轮幻觉累积抑制提供可供核查的方法线索；但该工作是文本到图像生成的视觉 CoT，不涉及 VLM 答案推理，迁移需自行判断。
